about_the_game:
The world is decaying into ruin, as it has been overrun with monsters.

As a newly awakened "Captain", you must recruit "Waifu" in order to save the world!

Upon waking into a strange world, you are greeted by the Goddess of Dragons. She is irritated at having to deal with people who only play demos and don't buy the full game. She offers very basic advice in order to survive in this world, but quickly abandons the player right before they can challenge the Slime Boss, preventing progress unless the full game is purchased. What nerve!

The demo has many features, despite the Goddess of Dragon's efforts to prevent access to more content:

  • Offline Mode, doesn't require Live-Service (some features disabled: Chat, Guilds, Coop, PVP)

  • Save data works in full game (Offline mode only)

  • Daily "Idle" Rewards (cumulative with no maximum)

  • Uncapped Player Level (gain crystals on levelup)

  • Gacha banners: Trash-Chan (required story) Standard Banner Free Reroll Banner Free Ticket Banner Event Banners

  • Quests, up to 2-star difficulty: Adoption, Capture, Gathering, Harvest, Hunting, Mining, Urgent (story)

  • Event Minigames: World Boss, Nature Towers, Waifu-Tuber, Waifu Survivor, Waifu Fish

  • Waifus can star-up to max, as well as reach level 200 (max)

  • Equipment can upgrade to Tier 2 (of 7)

  • Magic Cats can train to Tier 2 (of 7)

  • Create up to 5 squads (of 10; can't create Online squads for Warbands and PVP)

  • School: Re-train Waifu skills (Grey book only = random skill)

  • Marketplace: Up to tier 2 equipment & items (of 7)

  • Microtransactions aren't available in Offline mode

  • Customize Waifus: Only Hair Styles & Color

  • Can build all buildings available in Offline mode, Level 2 maximum upgrade (of 7)

Purchase the Full Version to gain access to:

  • Online mode! In-game mail rewards, PVP, Coop, Guilds, Chat

  • Access everything beyond Tier 2

  • All Gacha banners available (requires upgrading the "Gacha Castle" to Tier 7)

  • Create up to 10 squads, including Online modes for Warbands and PVP

  • Able to re-train all Waifu skills, including specific ones with matching-nature categories

  • Marketplace sells all equipment and items (upgrade in-game as story progresses)

  • Full Waifu customization!

  • Can build all buildings in the Townbuilder!

  • Venture to defeat the Slime Boss, and everything beyond!

short_description: Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to defeat the Demon King! Players will recruit many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters.
